name: fenzo-meta
description: Meta repo coordinating the Fenzo frontend (fenzo-app) and backend (fenzit-be) repos for AI-assisted, cross-repo development.

scripts.preinstall: node -e "if (!/pnpm/.test(process.env.npm_config_user_agent||'')) { console.error('\nThis repo uses pnpm only. Run: pnpm install\n'); process.exit(1); }"
